name: Grok for Excel
desc: Excel add-in that answers questions, writes formulas and runs scenarios.
desc_zh: Excel 加载项，用自然语言回答问题、写公式并做情景推演。
solves: Spreadsheet questions stall on remembering the right function; describe the outcome and the formula appears beside your data.
solves_zh: 表格问题常常卡在记不起该用哪个函数；描述想要的结果，公式就出现在数据旁边。
best_for: You have a cash-receipts sheet and want to know what moved and why without writing a pivot table.
best_for_zh: 手上有一张收款表，想看清哪儿变了、为什么，又不想做数据透视表时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory; channel A Microsoft Marketplace listing）。 One of four Grok Office add-ins released in June and July 2026 (Word 2026-06-18, PowerPoint 2026-06-16, Excel 2026-07-20, Outlook 2026-07-21). They are separate installable products, matching how the ledger already records Copilot add-ins per Office application. The marketplace URL redirects by dropping the locale segment. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对 ChatGPT for Excel、Microsoft 365 Copilot 的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/introducing-excel-addin 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/WA200011056?tab=Overview）。
